mechanism: The review action is tied to source-print existence instead of the saved settlement result.
trigger: A print is deleted after settlement and the user closes the result panel.
expectedBehavior: A session-level action remains available to reopen the saved settlement receipt.
incorrectBehavior: The only receipt review control disappears when the print no longer exists.
reproduction: Call actions(savedResult, false); it returns no action even though a receipt is available.
unacceptableAllegations: Alleging unrelated vulnerabilities or claiming secret disclosure without evidence.
